svg.title: Conservative frustum culling / 保守包围球视锥裁剪

g.text: VISUAL LAB / ROUND 22 / RADIUS-PADDED FRUSTUM PLANES · ZERO EDGE POPS · NO CUDA CLAIM
Pad the plane by radius r; stop edge popping. / 将视锥平面外扩半径 r，消除边缘闪烁消失。
54 solids · 13/13 checks · padded kept 11/11 vs center-only 7/11 (4 false pops)
8192 CPU 18-sphere cull passes: signed plane distance 5.71 ms / 72-point boundary sampling 12.82 ms
单位向内平面法向满足 n·c + d >= -r 即可保留跨边界球体，消除中心点裁剪在 14° 摇摄角下的 4 颗可见球体漏裁。
